text: てもちに　つれていけない　ポケモンが　います

structure.jp: つれていけない　ポケモンが
structure.en: a Pokémon that can't be taken along

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つれていけない　ポケモンが
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a noun tells you which kind of thing it is. つれていけない　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that can't be taken along'.
